quotes.text: BlackRock Liquidity Funds T-Fund Institutional Class 4.83 % 26,526,567 $ 26,527 $ 26,527 3.42 %

hypotheses: Cause found: the money-market line 'Blackrock T-Fund Inst' (6,838) is published with asset_category FUND, asset_class OTHER, exposure FUND (index class CASH), so the like-for-like split (investments_total_excludes) does not take it out of the non-cash sum: residual 1.09 pct = 6,838 / 626,799. A real classification defect, not as filed.

Tried 1 (ncxc, ncxd): row corrections of asset_category, then also asset_class and exposure_type, to CASH. A later step of the unified build puts asset_class OTHER / exposure FUND back after the correction step, and the final schema check (cash_classification_consistency) stops the build. Withdrawn.
Tried 2 (diagnostic run of the unified stage only): adding 'blackrock\s+t-fund' to the wrapper's cash family pattern drops the row altogether (6.8M lost). Withdrawn.
Not tried: finding which step after the row corrections rewrites asset_class / exposure_type for an index-class CASH row whose issuer_category is FUND; needs a code read beyond this run.
